title: Choose the visual world for the Green Campus console
question: The roll assigned the IMD Heat Bulletin. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: IMD Heat Bulletin
options.lineage: IMD heat-wave bulletins and INSAT infrared imagery
options.thesis: The floor read like a summer heat map: where it burns power, it glows.
options.viewport: Side rail, a top strip of floor kW, waste and temperature, the 2nd-floor plan as a live load heat map, a ranked waste queue with Cut buttons, and a 24h load ribbon with a scrubber.
options.risk: The warning ramp doubles as state colour; it must stay disciplined or everything looks alarming.

raised.raise: One time scrubber drives every panel at once: drag it and the map, numbers and queue replay that moment.
The cut-load action owns one reserved colour used nowhere else.
State changes snap in two quick frames; nothing fades or eases.
One family carries headings, labels and data; hierarchy comes from size and weight only.

options.label: Single-Line Diagram
options.lineage: electrical single-line diagrams on LT panel drawings
options.thesis: The floor drawn the way its electrician sees it: incomer, busbar, a feeder per room, live kW on every line.
options.viewport: Side rail, the floor as a horizontal single-line diagram with each feeder's kW, breaker symbols that act as Cut switches, and a feeder table below.
options.risk: Light ground in a dim server room, and the most familiar engineering choice; non-electrical staff may need a legend.

options.label: Gate Board
options.thesis: Rooms ranked like departures by waste; a row that changes stays lit until it is acknowledged.
options.viewport: Side rail, a full-width board of rooms ranked by live waste with state, kW and Cut, plus a compact floor strip and load ribbon below.
options.case: Wins on clarity for all-day glancing, since changes persist until acknowledged; weaker audience identification.
options.risk: The floor plan becomes secondary; spatial sense of the floor is lost.

options.label: Metro Diagram
options.lineage: Delhi Metro network map (the Violet Line reaches Faridabad)
options.thesis: Each load type is a line; rooms are stations; a lit station is a room drawing power.
options.viewport: Side rail, the floor as a 4-line metro diagram (AC, lights, fans, AV) through the rooms, with a waste list and load ribbon.
options.case: Strong local identification; loses on clarity because one room splits across four lines.
options.risk: Reads as a poster if the lines carry more than load state.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Today's schedule as a purple course over the floor's terrain.
options.viewport: Floor plan as terrain with the day's classes as numbered controls.
options.case: Loses both axes: the audience does not orienteer, and the course metaphor blurs waste.
options.kept: The cut-load action owns one reserved colour, as the course owns purple.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: Rooms as plates on an uncoated sheet.
options.viewport: A 4-up grid of room plates with credit rows.
options.case: Loses both axes: editorial calm hides urgency and does not read as an ops tool.
options.kept: One family carries display and data alike.

options.label: Acetate Manual
options.thesis: Each page a tabbed section with acetate leaves.
options.viewport: A coloured tab rail with leafed content.
options.case: Loses both axes: layered leaves slow scanning.
options.risk: Heavy layering on a glance tool.
options.kept: State changes snap in two frames; no easing.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: One slider morphs the whole grid live.
options.viewport: A giant figure with a live readout.
options.case: Loses both axes: nothing to do with energy work.
options.kept: One scrubber drives every panel continuously.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark terminal-style ops dashboard, the Bloomberg/Grafana look done properly.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar, a tiled grid of KPI tiles, charts, a room table and an event log.
